abstract: Let $N_\lambda(X)$ count primitive positive triples $a+b=c\le X$ with $\operatorname{rad}(abc)<c^\lambda$. We prove $N_1(X)\ll_\varepsilon X^{589903/1000008+\varepsilon}$, improving the bound $3622/6139<59/100$ obtained from our original rational tree. The arithmetic input strengthens the collision inequalities used with the anatomic decomposition, Fourier estimate and geometry of numbers of Bernert, Browning, Lichtman and Teräväinen. Quadratic and cubic coordinate groups control nonzero differences within a single letter, and a multiplicative-energy estimate uniform in a unit twist releases additional coordinates of the other letter. A whole-monomial residue-class bound supplies another refinement. Five complete rational trees give the exponents $24811/50480$, $677/1240$, $589903/1000008$, $4041/6440$ and $648/1007$ at radical budgets $0.80$, $0.90$, $1.00$, $1.05$ and $1.10$, respectively. All five strictly improve the specified earlier program bounds. Reusing the original tree also gives an explicit piecewise affine envelope and the exponent $59/100$ for $0<\lambda\le501403/501400$. The supplement reconstructs every inequality and verifies complete branch coverage and nonnegative rational multipliers using only the Python standard library, with fault-injection controls. The results are upper bounds; no optimality of the strengthened program or solution of the abc conjecture is asserted.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Corrected the parenthetical comparison attribution after Theorem 1.2 in Section 1 to state the exact main-tree envelope values certified in [2, Theorem 1.2(c)], namely E_1(1.05) = 89/140 and E_1(1.10) = 6239/9170 (replacing 982/1565 and 197/313), while retaining the distinction from the earlier ungrouped computational benchmarks 113/180 and 356/553.
- Corrected the dependency explanation in Appendix A to state that the exact rational certificate verifiers (check.py, parameters.py, and verify_grid.py) run in a pure Python standard-library environment because they do not import engine.py, solve.py, or run_grid.py, rather than claiming guarded try/except imports inside engine.py or solve.py.
title: Squares and twisted energy in the exceptional set of the abc conjecture
